svg.title: Rag Pdf Genie
svg.desc: RAG PDF Genie: ask a 115-page IRS PDF questions with a fully local LLM (Ollama llama3.2 with nomic-embed-text), ChromaDB vectors, a multi-query retriever with query rewrites, and a Streamlit UI. No API keys; the document never leaves the machine.
